user.title: Connect the Tata EV
user.description: Battery, charging, and air conditioning are read from iRA.ev every 30 seconds. Use the vehicleId and x-api-key headers from a vehicle-health request, and the refreshToken from a refresh-token request.

error.invalid_auth: iRA.ev rejected this session. Check the vehicle ID, API key, and refresh token.

abort.already_configured: This car is already set up.
